title: kith-peer: replyTo validated after chat row created, leaving orphans on failure
description: In Peer/deliver, chat resolution (which may CREATE a new chat row) executes at lines ~184-237, then replyTo validation at ~244-261. If replyTo fails validation, the newly-created chat row is left orphaned. The UNIQUE INDEX on (contact_id, kind=direct) limits this to one orphaned row per sender, but it still violates the stated step ordering (step 6=validate replyTo, step 7=get/create chat) and leaves DB in inconsistent state. Fix: wrap chat creation + replyTo validation in a single transaction so replyTo failure rolls back the chat creation.
